en.text: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.
For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

zhSimplified.text: 因为你是赐我力量的 神，为何丢弃我呢？

zhTraditional.text: 因為你是賜我力量的上帝，為何丟棄我呢？

en.text: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.

zhSimplified.text: 求你发出你的亮光和真实，好引导我，

zhTraditional.text: 求你發出你的亮光和真實，好引導我，

en.text: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. will praise you on the harp, God, my God.

zhSimplified.text: 我就走到 神的祭坛，

en.text: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior, my helper, and my God.

zhSimplified.text: 我的心哪，你为何忧闷？ ，是我的 神。

zhTraditional.text: 我的心哪，你為何憂悶？ ，是我的上帝。
